page_annotations: This verso carries supplementary material keyed by gutter arrows to entries on the facing fol. 222.

coverage.finding: Pencil '221b' with a superscript b in the top-left corner. It matches the supplied folio label fol. 221b.

Faint pencil 'm' with a long oblique stroke at about x 2830, y 690-850. It is not attached to any entry on this page. A similar 'm/' appears in the left margin of fol. 222, but nothing on either page securely links the two.

Faint pencil letter with a macron and an oblique stroke at about y 1260-1420. 'ū' is an uncertain reading and is correctly kept as uncertain. Fol. 221 has a similar pencil mark in its left margin, but no link is secure.

'ff.1-10(m.2,5), S.1886. Owner Gopāla' is in ink. There is a small comma-like stroke below the closing bracket. The gutter arrow ← is beside it. On fol. 222, 'Gopāla. ←' is visible level with the d.334(4) Rāmanavamī line, which supports the probable relationship.

'c.159(4)' is written above the start of the line. The line reads 'Do., + ṭippaṇī in Hindi, ff.1-6, S.1925. R.L. Mitra' and ends with the date column '1868:6:12:D.'. A long arrow ← runs into the gutter. The 'Do.' antecedent remains unresolved.
Faint pencil 's' with a long oblique stroke above the 1798 date column, and a second 's' between the d.59 and d.58 date columns. Attachment is uncertain and is correctly kept so.
'+ dīpikā' is written above the line, with a caret below after 'Up.'. It is represented in r006.
The d.59(1) entry runs over two lines and ends with the date column '1798:24:11/19:D.'. Both lines are present in r006.

The struck-through words before '[by Ānandavana]' look like 'to' plus a superscript mark, then 'Rāmakāśikā'. This is only partly legible, and an opening bracket may precede it. r006 records it with a [reading?] flag and an uncertainty note.
The d.58(8) line has a tick and the date column 'n.d.:11:9/11:D'. The '(8)' is somewhat uncertain, and r008 flags it.
'Rāmabhaṭṭa, Śrīkramacandrikā' is an independent author/title cross-reference. A line seems to run under 'Rāmabhaṭṭa', but its extent is unclear, as r009 notes.
'Rāmabhadra Miśra, Ṣaṭpadīvivaraṇa.' is an independent cross-reference with no shelfmark.
An interlinear 'ā' is written above 'Sārva'. The final vowel of 'Kiraṇāvali' appears short in the source, but the reading is flagged.
'and Padārthakhaṇḍana.' is the indented continuation of b013.
'Rāmavarman s/o Himatīvarman, Setu, comm. on Adhyātmarāmāyaṇa'. The father's name is kept uncertain.
'and on Rāmahṛdaya.' is the continuation of b015.
